underlying_source: AGMARKNET statewise monthly price and arrivals records
aggregation: All-India arrivals-weighted mean of state-level monthly modal prices: sum(price_rs_qtl * arrivals_t) / sum(arrivals_t).
quality_filter: State-month rows with arrivals_t >= 50.0 tonnes, valid positive price and valid arrivals.
note: This is a national state-aggregated series, not a single mandi. The published extract starts in January 2019. The output keeps only the most recent uninterrupted run ending October 2026; any earlier gaps are excluded, not filled. This is not a single-mandi series.
